rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home interior (flooring, drywall, stored contents) caused by failure of the policyholder's own plumbing system is a clear property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement suffered significant water damage from a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days while the policyholder was away. The damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall to approximately one foot high, and ruined stored items. This high-severity claim will require prompt mitigation and on-site assessment.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to one foot high; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.claimant_discovery: returned from work trip to find flooding
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles) with no third-party involvement or theft; straightforward property damage claim.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang on 1/6/25; approximately 4 shingles blown off. No interior water damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Note: Repair cost falls below the $2,500 deductible.

case_facts.description: approximately 4 shingles blown off by wind; no interior water damage
